title: Hirundo, Lazarus, and others are applying machine unlearning and weight edits to Chinese models to remove censorship and harden security for Western companies (Rest of World)
summary: Rest of World: Hirundo, Lazarus, and others are applying machine unlearning and weight edits to Chinese models to remove censorship and harden security for Western companies — A growing number of startups are editing powerful Chinese open-weight models for Western businesses that are concerned about censorship and security.
